ValidationRule.description: Check to make sure that "Primary Quote" is blank before "Fee Inclusive" box can be checked
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NSP_Has_Primary_Quote__c = TRUE, ISCHANGED( Fee_Inclusive__c ), Fee_Inclusive__c = TRUE, NOT(ISPICKVAL( NSP_PrimaryProduct__c, "WO")), NOT(ISPICKVAL( NSP_PrimaryProduct__c, "WS")), NOT(ISPICKVAL( NSP_PrimaryProduct__c, "Performance Management")), NOT(ISPICKVAL( NSP_PrimaryProduct__c, "Time & Attendance")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Fee Inclusive Opportunity can not have an assigned Primary Quote, and must have a Primary Product of: WO, WS, Performance Management, or Time & Attendance
